Experimental alpha.5 adds destination preflight and guarded migration into **new private personal repositories** on GitHub/GitLab cloud and self-hosted instances, through the desktop and CLI.

Prepare an encrypted 15-minute plan, review the destination instance/actor, source SHA-256 and exact heads/tags, then reenter credentials and type the exact destination path to execute. Source history is authenticated and independently verified before creation. Destination automation is disabled before upload. Required atomic pushes use exact old/absent ref leases and a unique creation guard; independent fresh-clone/fsck/ref/HEAD verification gates success. Existing repositories are refused. Intent, partial outcome and verified receipts stay encrypted in the vault and its same-key backups.

This first write workflow supports personal namespaces, SHA-1 snapshots with an existing symbolic default branch, up to 128 heads/tags and 8 KiB total ref-name bytes. GitHub needs classic repo+workflow scopes; GitLab needs personal api+write_repository scopes. GitLab's new source default is protected for maintainers with force pushes disabled. No organization/group creation, existing-repository adoption, automatic retry/rollback, external LFS/submodule payload transfer or hosting issues/PR metadata transfer is included. Notes/internal refs stay in the source archive. Incomplete operations can leave a new private repository and partial data; inspect encrypted receipts rather than rerunning a consumed plan.

Existing local/HTTPS capture, full-history local restore, read-only plans, encrypted storage and portable same-identity backup recovery remain supported. Git snapshot and backup formats are unchanged; remote manifest v2 requires alpha.4 or newer. No hosting token is stored in plans, archives, backups, preferences or activity. Lock clears decrypted metadata.

Installed Git 2.48+ and verified working storage are required: ext4/XFS on mounted LUKS for Linux, EFS for Windows. Linux desktop requires writable /dev/shm tmpfs for its private browser profile; Windows uses incognito WebView2. OS swap/dump policy is separate.

Choose **repo-stealer-desktop-*** for graphical installers: Linux x86_64 DEB/RPM/AppImage or Windows x86_64 NSIS setup EXE. Other packages are the CLI. SHA256SUMS is included. Source commits and version tags are SSH-signed; installers are not OS code-signed. Native DEB/AppImage/NSIS workflows and version checks gate publication; desktop RPM packaging/digests are checked, while Fedora/openSUSE desktop RPM installation remains untested.

This is an experimental application without independent application security review. Read docs/GUARDED-MIGRATIONS.md for supported credentials, exact safeguards, administrative-race boundaries and recovery instructions. Keep a verified encrypted backup.
